rationale: C17 plausibly supplied the child’s temporary statutory-suspension template: it identifies specified statutory provisions, predicates suspension on a presidential necessity finding, and limits the suspension by a defined period. The child compresses that machinery into a single sentence and adapts the factual basis, statute, and duration. C09 shares a fiscal-year limitation but concerns amendments and continuation of an order, while C15 concerns the Panama Canal but merely postpones a proclamation’s effective date; neither supplies as close a drafting structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Finding such action necessary because of a shortage of housing, I hereby suspend for the fiscal year 1949 the application of those portions of the cited sections
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS I find that the extraordinary emergency described in the said Executive order and constituting the basis of the suspension effected thereby still exists
shared_material.explanation: Both use a presidential finding of continuing necessity or emergency as the predicate for suspending identified statutory provisions.
